summary: A pairing of an established actress and a younger guest with a puppy-dog energy. Viewers describe the dynamic as a beautiful girl paired with a younger boy type, note the genuine nature of the interaction, and immediately ask for a drama series and for them to be brought back. The comment rate is lower than typical idol pairings (1,228 on 740K views), consistent with the pattern that non-idol guests depress engagement.
